title.native: ナカノヒトゲノム【実況中】

description:
Iride Akatsuki is a popular game footage uploader. He wakes up one day to find that he's been kidnapped and taken to a strange place, along with a number of other uploaders who specialize in different genres of games.

A mysterious alpaca-headed host gathers them after the initial stage, to explain how the game will proceed. Will the group of gamers clear the game and make it back to their real lives?

(Source: Kirei Cake)

node.description:
Akatsuki is one of the main characters and a member of the 13th District. His specialty is escape games.

Akatsuki is portrayed as a relatively nice and open-minded person who doesn't get mad easily, whether it is at something or someone. His patience—which may be on the more extreme end—has led to some members, most prominently [Anya](https://anilist.co/character/132431/Kudou-Anya), to rely on him fairly often and/or view him as something like a brother, if not a friend. 

In addition to not getting mad himself, Akatsuki also tries his best to make others around him happy. In fact, if someone tells him to do something, he'll do it without much hesitation if it will make that someone happy. Despite this though, there are some occasions when he doesn't follow orders, acting based on his own beliefs instead. He is shown to be a very calm and peaceful person, as he doesn't seem fazed when he sees monsters or other enemies.

Oshigiri Zakuro is a stealth-type game uploader, characterized by his masked mouth and ability to conceal his presence well even in real life. He is often stoic but harbors a shy side especially around women, which makes him a target of Yuzu's teasing.

Aikawa Makino is a quiet and handsome love-game streamer who sleeps almost all the time and lets his eyes do most of the talking for him. A running gag in the series is how anyone, male or female, who looks into his eyes for five seconds can be charmed by him.

He is a fighter-game uploader, which suits his often angry, cynical and violent attitude. This attitude partially stems from his sleep disorder which gives him regular periods of insomnia, causing him to have to take sleeping pills most of the time and take up game streaming to get rid of boredom during the night. He eventually befriends [Akatsuki](https://anilist.co/character/132425/Iride-Akatsuki), but quarrels a lot with [Zakuro](https://anilist.co/character/132432/Oshigiri-Zakuro) throughout the series.
Onigasaki is one of the main characters and a member of the 13th District. His specialty is traditional Japanese games, such as the Sengoku series.

Roromori Yuzu is a cheerful puzzle-and-maze game streamer that enjoys teasing her teammates, especially [Karin](https://anilist.co/character/132427/Sarayashiki-Karin). She met [Akatsuki](https://anilist.co/character/132425/Iride-Akatsuki) online before and the two were planning to do a collaboration together before entering the game. Underneath her ditzy and sarcastic personality though, she harbors a genius-like intellect and an unhealthy obsession for Akatsuki. She is the oldest in the group, thus she's the leader.

Karin Sarayashiki is a beautiful and popular horror-game streamer hailed as the #1 Female Game Streamer People Want to be Stepped on by online, known as "the Cursed Princess". 

Despite coming across as initially aggressive and confrontational, she is actually easily scared despite being an avid player of horror games and can be sensitive and caring to her friends. She becomes [Yuzu](https://anilist.co/character/132428/Roromori-Yuzu)'s best female friend.
Himiko Inaba is a timid and kind nurturing-simulation game streamer who often helps out with domestic chores during emergencies. She carries flash grenades around for self-defense.

Anya and Shinya Kudou's older brother.

Not much is known about him. He died in a car crash as he was going to get chocolate for his brothers.

__Birthday:__ November 11 (Scorpio)

Chihiro, known as Hiro to his friends, is one of the minor characters along with Sakura and Nanami that were trapped in the Underground Channels after being penalized in the White Room. He was also part of the 11th Avenue.

His personality seems to be that he is very protective of Sakura, but it is also hinted that he may have some feelings for Sakura and greatly misunderstands Onigasaki's intentions towards her. He also the "Easy to Rile Type" according to Onigasaki's first impression of him.

The only thing known about his background was that he was trapped in the 11th Avenue along with Sakura, and then tried to get himself penalized so he could get to the White Room to accompany Sakura and together find a way out of here. Then, he and Sakura presumably found the tunnel and met Nanami; staying down there ever since.

A part of The Underground Comrade and is Zakuro's younger sister.

Sakura is shown to be quiet, kind and caring and very considerate of other people, but is usually scolded because she wanders off on her own a lot to get stuff for other people. She is also shown to be very guilty of hurting Zakuro once in the past and doesn't want to be a burden to her brother any more. Thus, she asks Kaikoku to not tell her brother she was in the Underground.

She was also once a gamer and then was put in the game as part of the 11th avenue, but then got penalized and sent to the White Room. There, she was united with Chihiro who tried to get himself penalized as well to keep each other company and find a way out of there. After finding the secret passage, they meet Nanami and the three stayed underground for the rest of the following years until Kaikoku found the tunnel and was brought to their underground shelter, finding out her brother was in this game as well.

The second child of the Kudou siblings. Having to be a responsible older brother for his younger brother, he couldn't even cry in front of [Anya](https://anilist.co/character/132431/Kudou-Anya) at their older brother's funeral. He was the only one who didn't suffer from sleep disorder among the siblings and found it unfair. He became a medical student for the sake of Anya.

A panda teen made by the imagination of Akatsuki Iride who thought of Pantarou, Anya Kudou who thought of a female, Himiko Inaba who wanted a healthy child who is honest and kind, and Makino Aikawa who thought of an afro. Their thoughts then combined to make Ueno Murasaki as she hatched out of an egg. This was for Stage 3, a nurturing game that tasked the players to 'hatch' a girl from a large egg given by Paca and then make the school idol fall in love with her.

One of the minor characters that was penalized to the White Room and now is currently sheltering underground along with [Chihiro](https://anilist.co/character/162370/Akafuda-Chihiro) and [Sakura](https://anilist.co/character/162374/Sakura-Oshigiri).

Nanami is mostly calm and collected and acts as the elder to Sakura and Chihiro, he is extremely smart and can craft equipments easily using spare still usable parts.

Nanami was part of the 9th Avenue along with his friend who went missing when patrolling, not knowing that he has stumbled upon an island and then was forced to become Carmine. Before that, he was penalized in the White Room and then dug the escape route with the help of [Niki](https://anilist.co/character/162375/Niki-Ichiya), his friend. Then, he met Sakura and Chihiro and is currently still down there.
A demon that abducts young maidens alongside her grandfather [Kihachi](https://anilist.co/character/143600/Kihachi).

The biological mother of [Akatsuki Iride](https://anilist.co/character/132425/Iride-Akatsuki) and the adoptive mother of Akira.

~!On the outside, she is a kind, normal mother and cares for her family deeply, but then after the death of her son, she adopts Akira (Akatsuki), but then her husband dies due to a laboratory accident and she loses her sanity, she becomes broken and pretends Akatsuki's a handmade doll. She was seen in Ichiya's flashbacks saying that he can only be normal around his broken sister, showing that she cares for him a lot. When Ichiya returns to the house, Yukako says that she's okay, since he had to take care of her all these years, so she's okay.!~
The village elder of Kakuriyo village. He's a demon who abducts young maiden alongside his granddaughter Kikka.
